Avery (oncall): handing off — I'm dropping at 23:30 PT. Quick notes:
- embeddings: p50 stable, but p95 jumped ~3x after today's canary (v3-quant). Watch embeddings.p95 and embeddings.kv_cache_miss_rate.
- prefetcher: we're seeing a handful of cold-starts on the dev-dedicated pool; infra queued a warmup job.
- rollout: v3-quant at 40% with fallback to cpu-quant if OOM. No critical errors yet.
Action items: please ack, and if you see token latency >30s open a pager and @channel.

Priya: acked. I'll stay on for the first 90m. Where's the runbook for the embeddings latency?

Avery (oncall): runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency
Quick checks: ```kubectl -n rwd logs -l app=embeddings -c model --tail=200```
Metric query to watch: `sum(rate(embeddings_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)`
Prefetch warmup job: `jobs/prefetch-warmup-v2` (status should become Succeeded).

Jules: I'll be on backup for the overnight window and reachable by phone if pager escalates. Also: CR #812 (batching heuristics) is still pending; if latency gets worse I can revert that.

Kai: pinged infra to bump prefetch concurrency to 4 for an hour. They confirmed and kicked the job; will post metrics in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout v3-quant -> 40% traffic at 2026-03-18T22:45Z :rocket:

Priya: noted. If KV cache miss rate > 0.1 we should toggle prefix-caching on route `embed-prod` (runbook section 4). That usually drops p95 back to baseline quickly.

Avery (oncall): checklist I'm leaving: 1) watch embeddings.p95 and kv_cache_miss_rate, 2) confirm no OOMs in model pods, 3) monitor prefetch job status, 4) keep CR #812 rollback ready.
If someone takes the handoff, reply `handoff: <name>`.

Jules: handoff: Jules — taking coverage at 00:00 PT. I'll keep an eye on pages and CR #812.

Kai: infra update: prefetch concurrency bumped, cold-start errors down from 7/min to ~1/min. I'll keep watching for 15m.

Priya: thanks — switching my status to DND for the handoff window. Good luck :thumbsup:

Avery (oncall): thanks team, closing handoff. If anything urgent pages me, but Jules is primary.
